title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for acceleration must be correctly calculated as 10 m/s².

title: Exit velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for exit velocity must be correctly calculated as √10 m/s (≈3.16 m/s).

title: Railgun power output
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for power must be correctly calculated as (√10)/5 W (≈0.632 W).

title: Apply Lorentz force law
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the Lorentz force (F = BId) as the accelerating force on the projectile.

title: Apply Newton's second law
description: Important: For part (1), the solution must use Newton's second law (a = F/m) with the correct force.

title: Apply work-energy theorem
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly relate work done by the force (BId*L) to the kinetic energy gained.

title: Power from force and velocity
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must correctly calculate instantaneous power as P = F*v = (BId)*v.

title: Incorrect force expression
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect expression for the magnetic force (e.g., F = BIL, missing the spacing d).

title: Kinematics misuse
description: Pitfall: Attempting to solve for exit velocity using constant-acceleration kinematics without verifying constant force/acceleration conditions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates consistent use of SI units throughout the calculation.
